description_en: Queries the list of device groups under the current Alibaba Cloud account by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的设备组列表
name: ListDeviceGroups

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The device label name. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 设备标签名称。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The collection of device group IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 设备组ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: device_group_ids
